WITH np AS (
  SELECT bank, value, doc_id, page_no
  FROM figures
  WHERE metric = 'net_profit' AND year = 2024
), hi AS (
  SELECT * FROM np ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT 1
), lo AS (
  SELECT * FROM np ORDER BY value ASC LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  hi.bank AS highest_bank,
  hi.value AS highest_net_profit,
  hi.doc_id AS highest_doc_id,
  hi.page_no AS highest_page_no,
  lo.bank AS lowest_bank,
  lo.value AS lowest_net_profit,
  lo.doc_id AS lowest_doc_id,
  lo.page_no AS lowest_page_no,
  hi.value - lo.value AS difference_chf_m
FROM hi CROSS JOIN lo;
